annotation.justification: The clause uses 'MAY', granting discretion to the receiver. While the reference to 'common TCP implementations' provides some guidance, it doesn't mandate a specific autotuning mechanism, nor does it define the acceptable range of frequencies or amounts. This is permitted discretion, not ambiguity.
